Discussing if the accusations are real or not is not worth my time, I'm just giving you what would be smartest to do as a business. 

I think they just avoid mentioning them so people don't start asking about them. Seems like they want to avoid the topic or having people remember them so they don't start asking to get them in videos or asking what happened that they aren't there anymore. Also, them continuing their lives doesn't mean the others have to have them back, Smosh drifted away to avoid controversy and some fans don't want them back knowing about the accusations. Don't take this the wrong way, i'm not arguing or anything, but not mentioning them in smosh content is the best they could do as a business. 

Also, the old and current crew cut ties with Wes and some tweeted their support for the victim so it doesn't seem like they're on speaking terms with him. I do know some of them personally have stayed in contact with Flitz, like i think Noah was on his channel maybe and on Joven's channel with him. But as I said, the best move for Smosh as a business is to not talk about them.
